mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_purchase_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND purchase_id = #{purchaseId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM biz_purchase_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT receipt.*, CAST(ledger.ledger_id AS CHAR) AS ledger_id, (reversal.ledger_id IS NOT NULL) AS reversed, CAST(reversal.ledger_id AS CHAR) AS reversal_ledger_id FROM biz_purchase_receipt receipt LEFT JOIN oa_consumable_ledger ledger ON ledger.tenant_id = receipt.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND ledger.source_biz_id = receipt.id AND ledger.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN oa_consumable_ledger reversal ON reversal.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id AND reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id = ledger.ledger_id WHERE receipt.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receipt.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} ORDER BY receipt.id DESC
